children: Umm Al Qura for Development and Construction Company (Masar) and Alinma Second Development Company have sold four land plots in Masar Destination in Makkah to develop three residential and one hospitality tower.
The plots were sold to Al-Diyar Al-Arabia (Arabian Dyar) for 603.76 million Saudi riyals ($160.79 million), the developer said in a statement to the Saudi stock exchange.
Alinma Second Development Company is a special purpose vehicle of Alinma Makkah Development Fund II, which is fully owned by Masar.
The land plots, totaling 12,157 square metres (sqm), are located in Zone 3 and are non-boulevard-facing. The book value of the land plots is SAR 259.47 million.
The proceeds will finance working capital and ongoing projects, the statement said.

title: Makkah's Masar Destination to get new residential, hospitality towers
